name: FRAN — Family Resource Advocacy Network
notes: Rethemed 2026-08-14 to the FRAN Style Guide (October 2025) mockup — blue/green/yellow/brown on white, Shantell Sans + Nunito, tight radii, no doodles. styles.css is the designer's file verbatim (examples/fran/css/styles.css) — keep it pristine; site adjustments live in sitehub.css. Fonts are self-hosted rather than the mockup's Google Fonts CDN. Restructured 2026-08-31 per client PDF (FRAN Website Updates 8.26.26): the one-pager exploded into distinct pages — /find-support (provider cards, grey name-mark links out to each partner site), /about, /events, /contact — with no scroll-to anchors in the nav. Partner names/descriptions and their outbound URLs are baked in per the PDF; the four home service-area cards carry an Explore Partners <details> dropdown listing the same links. Exception: Fostering Hope Initiative links to /about (FHI manages FRAN itself, so an outbound link is ambiguous) — pending the client saying what FHI should point to. Contact form removed at client direction (email-only via Info@FranSalem.com) — the platform form can be restored by re-adding <x-site-form key="contact"> if they change their minds; a keyless Google Maps embed fills the slot because the new building doesn't surface in map searches yet. Events/classes stay on the Need Navigator feed via <x-site-events> — never replace with static listings; home shows the single closest upcoming event (limit=1) and /events renders the full feed. Footer is the dark brand blue (contrast-checked) with the all-white footer logo. Address is 3803 Lancaster Dr NE (3083 was a typo). Final production domain TBD — client will coordinate; keep current staging domain until then.
